Company Profile

About Pawan Traders

Your trusted multi-brand battery distributor, inverter specialist and rooftop solar turnkey EPC contractor in Puramufti (Prayagraj) and Charwa Town (Kaushambi).

15+ Years Track Record

Committed to Uninterrupted Power for Every Home & Vehicle

Founded with the principle of zero compromise on genuine products, Pawan Traders is one of eastern Uttar Pradesh's leading energy solution providers. We hold direct authorized dealerships for premier brands including Amaron, Exide, Luminous, Microtek, Vion Lithium, and UTL Solar.

Led by Director Mr. Pawan Kumar Kushwaha and Manager Mr. Kartik Kushwaha, our operations span two physical branches with on-site computerized battery testing benches, warranty exchange counters, and dedicated solar technical teams.

Our Mission

To provide 100% genuine energy storage and clean rooftop solar at fair, transparent prices with immediate local warranty support.

Our Vision

To power 5,000+ homes and enterprises across Prayagraj and Kaushambi with high-efficiency solar and lithium energy.
